_doc: A version 5 save from before Glim's and the crew's looks were found pieces (tests/test_crew_looks.gd, tools/orbit_roundtrip.gd): Glim with one upgrade, two looks bought (Sunset shell, Little Beanie) and wearing Sunset, Ember and Sprout; 5 hexes cleaned (the Sprout top opened at 4, the Moss shell at 6); two Builder parts in the bin (treads, top hat); the Neon Underglow won from Requests and worn fleet-wide; the Scoopie design wearing treads, the top hat, mint lights and the neon mark. The migration to version 6 must keep all of it as found pieces, and the robot light colours (free before) too.
